title: 1bfh19c
Maytham al-Tammar
hook: Imam Ali showed his date-selling friend the tree on which he would be hanged beforehand. In 60 AH that tree became the gallows.
scenes.0.text: In Kufa there was a date seller. His name was **Maytham al-Tammar**. He was a freed slave. He was among **Imam Ali**'s closest friends. He had received his knowledge from him. He strung dates in the market and mentioned Imam Ali's name with love. The door of the Ahl al-Bayt was open in front of this stall too.
scenes.0.art.actors.0.label: acwx6t
Maytham
scenes.0.art.actors.1.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.1.text: One day **Imam Ali** called **Maytham**. According to the report, he told him what would come afterward. "After me you will be hanged because of love for the Ahl al-Bayt. Your tongue will be cut off." He also showed him the date palm on which he would be hanged. Maytham would go to that tree, pray, and water its root. The tree was still only shade. He knew the death waiting in its shade.
scenes.1.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.1.art.actors.1.label: acwx6t
Maytham
scenes.2.text: When **Imam Ali** was martyred, **Mu'awiya** had him cursed from the pulpits. The Friday sermon opened with abuse. **Hujr b. Adi** and his companions, who could not bear this oppression, were killed. The friends of Imam Ali were forced into silence in Kufa. **Maytham** did not keep silent. He did not give up defending **Imam Ali**'s right. He did not stop telling of the virtue of the ==Ahl al-Bayt==.
scenes.2.art.actors.0.label: acwx6t
Maytham
scenes.3.text: It was 60 AH. **Mu'awiya** had died, and the order of oppression he had set up still stood. **Yazid**'s governor of Kufa, **Ubaydullah b. Ziyad**, had **Maytham** seized. He demanded tabarri from him. Tabarri is saying that one disassociates oneself from **Imam Ali**. Maytham refused. He did not deny Imam Ali's name. The prison was too narrow for the owner of a date stall.
scenes.3.art.actors.0.label: acwx6t
Maytham
scenes.3.art.actors.1.label: 165bwyt
Ibn Ziyad
scenes.4.text: **Maytham** was hanged on the date palm that **Imam Ali** had shown him years before. Even on the gallows he told the people of the virtue of the ==Ahl al-Bayt==. He listed the oppression of the Umayyads. When **Ibn Ziyad** heard this he had a bridle put on his mouth. He had his tongue cut off. Maytham was martyred there. It happened as Imam Ali had foretold. The hanging, the tongue and the tree were where he had said.
scenes.4.art.actors.0.label: acwx6t
Maytham
scenes.5.text: The same order would cut off the water at Karbala a year later. **Imam Husayn** did not pledge allegiance to **Yazid**. Kufa, where **Maytham** was hanged, was also the city that sent out that army. The word that ended under the date palm would continue on the bank of the Euphrates.
scenes.5.art.actors.1.label: 3qh9mj
Imam Husayn
shia.0.says: Imam Ali's foretelling to Maytham that he would be hanged, that his tongue would be cut off, and the date palm. Maytham praying beside that tree and watering it. Ibn Ziyad having him hanged in 60 AH. A page number was not given separately.
shia.1.says: That Maytham sold dates in Kufa, was a friend of Imam Ali, refused tabarri and was hanged. A page number was not given separately.
shia.2.says: The prophecy, the tree, the hanging, the bridle and the cutting of the tongue are related in this compilation. A page number was not given separately.
questions.0: Maytham knew the tree he would be hanged on years before. Even so, he watered the root of that tree. What does this waiting tell you?
questions.1: While Imam Ali was being cursed from the pulpits, Maytham did not keep silent. What does speaking love for the Ahl al-Bayt aloud teach you?
questions.2: Even on the gallows he told of his virtue. They cut off his tongue. Imam Ali's word came out to the letter. What does this scene announce to you before Karbala?
summary: Maytham al-Tammar was a date seller in Kufa and a friend of Imam Ali. Imam Ali foretold to him that he would be hanged, that his tongue would be cut off, and the tree. In 60 AH Ibn Ziyad demanded tabarri. Maytham refused. He was martyred on the foretold tree.
key: Maytham al-Tammar: martyrdom on the foretold date palm
notes.0: Maytham al-Tammar was a freedman who sold dates in Kufa and was a friend of Imam Ali.
notes.1: Imam Ali foretold to him that he would be hanged, that his tongue would be cut off, and the date palm.
notes.2: In Mu'awiya's time Imam Ali was cursed from the pulpits. Hujr b. Adi was killed. Maytham did not keep silent.
notes.3: In 60 AH Ubaydullah b. Ziyad demanded tabarri. Maytham refused.
notes.4: He was hanged on the foretold tree. They cut off his tongue. The prophecy came true to the letter.
